Alias for getHaderName above.
    *
    *@return String headerName

methods.name: public void setHeaderName(String hdrname)
methods.comment:
* Set the name of the header .
         * @param hdrname String to set

methods.name: public String getHeaderValue()
methods.comment:
Get the header value (i.e. what follows the name:).
    * This merely goes through and lops off the portion that follows
    * the headerName:

methods.name: public boolean isHeaderList()
methods.comment:
Return false if this is not a header list
    * (SIPHeaderList overrrides this method).
    *@return false

methods.name: public String encode()
methods.comment: Encode this header into canonical form.

methods.name: protected abstract String encodeBody()
methods.comment:
Encode the body of this header (the stuff that follows headerName).
    * A.K.A headerValue.

methods.name: protected StringBuffer encodeBody(StringBuffer buffer)
methods.comment:
Encode the body of this header in the given buffer.
     * Default implementation calls encodeBody();
